summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Digital Dawn Develop agency website. Backend: 100% pass rate (13/13 tests). Frontend: All major flows working with one CRITICAL UI bug found (order form submit button overlay issue).

minor_observations.issue: One old order in database has service IDs instead of service titles
minor_observations.details: Order from 'Budi' has services: ['landing-page', 'social-ads'] instead of full titles. New orders correctly store service titles like ['Landing Page Website', 'Content Creator']
minor_observations.impact: LOW - Does not affect new orders, likely from earlier testing

ui_bugs.issue: HTML overlay intercepts pointer events, preventing normal button clicks
ui_bugs.details: Users cannot click the submit button on /order page. The button is visible and enabled but an HTML element overlays it and intercepts all pointer events. Workaround: JavaScript click works, but this breaks normal user interaction.
ui_bugs.reproduction: 1. Go to /order page, 2. Select services and fill form, 3. Try to click 'Kirim Pesanan' button - click is intercepted by overlay
ui_bugs.suggested_fix: Check z-index and pointer-events CSS on form elements. Likely a modal/overlay component or the budget/deadline Select dropdowns are not properly closing and leaving an invisible overlay.

Frontend: Order submission shows success panel with confetti animation

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (1 critical UI bug found, all functionality works with workaround)

critical.issue: Order form submit button has overlay issue
critical.details: The submit button at [data-testid='order-form-submit-button'] cannot be clicked normally due to an HTML overlay intercepting pointer events. This is likely caused by the Select dropdowns (budget/deadline) not properly closing or a z-index/pointer-events CSS issue.
critical.suggested_fix: 1. Check if Select components are properly closing after selection, 2. Review z-index and pointer-events CSS on form elements, 3. Ensure no invisible overlays remain after dropdown interactions, 4. Test with force=True or JavaScript click as temporary workaround
critical.user_impact: HIGH - Users cannot submit orders using normal clicks, severely impacts core functionality
